name: oms-ingest-amps-a
description: AMPS feeds for system A instead of Kafka (docs/design/11 section 5, D17): a bookmark subscribe over the SOW topics' transaction log and the Derived Table Writer into OMS_RAW.OrdersA; the bookmark store under OMS_AMPS_BOOKMARK_DIR (shared storage). Enable this and disable oms-ingest-a when system A publishes to AMPS.
